collection.title: Renault Kangoo Express 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Kangoo Express 2008 Onwards model which requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
